relationships.ikki-kurogane: Lover and promised final opponent; she arrives in time to congratulate his first-round victory.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Friend/rival whose worry about Stella's training is recognized by Ikki.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Teacher for the last-minute training Stella pursues after losing to Ouma.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Recent defeat by Ouma drives her to train until the last moment.
relationships.mikoto-tsuruya: Scheduled first-round opponent, but Stella escalates the match conditions beyond a simple duel.

periods.summary: Stella is absent from the pre-tournament banquet because she continues intensive training with Nene Saikyo after being defeated by Ouma. A train delay caused by a rockslide makes her miss her original match start, but the committee postpones the bout. After Ikki defeats Moroboshi, Stella arrives openly confident, apologizes for being late, and voluntarily accepts punishment. Her true aim is not mere royal honesty: she refuses to let Akatsuki's B-block members avoid fighting each other and escape unscathed after the attack on Hagun. She therefore proposes that Mikoto Tsuruya, Reisen Hiraga, Rinna Kazamatsuri and Yui Tatara all fight her at once.

key_events.summary: Her B-block match is postponed because her train is delayed by a rockslide.
She arrives after Ikki's match and requests a special four-on-one penalty match.
